How it works
Who it is for
Availability
Demo site · hotline not configured
Report an incident. Coordinate the response.

One place for residents, dispatchers, responders, and the DMO to move a report from submission to closure.

Create a resident account
Staff sign in
Report
Verified
Team assigned
Resolved
Illustrative sample. Not live data.

Submitting a report through this app does not automatically guarantee immediate rescue. If you are in danger, call your local emergency hotline.

Residents

Create an account to send a report with photos and your location. You can follow each report until it is closed.

New here? Create an account
Already a resident? Sign in
Every report moves through the same steps.
Submitted

A resident sends the report with its location.

Verified

Dispatch confirms the situation before any team is sent.

Assigned

A rescue team is given the report.

In progress

The team posts updates as the response moves.

Resolved

The team reports the situation is under control.

Closed

Staff review the final record and close it.

Each status change is recorded, so staff and the resident can see what happened and when.

Who it is for
Residents
Send a report with photos and your location, then follow its status.
Responders
Acknowledge assignments and post rescue updates from the field.
Dispatchers
Verify, prioritize, and assign reports to a team.
DMO
Monitor incident trends and export summaries.
Where it is available
Website
Open to staff with an account, and to residents who register.
Mobile app
Not publicly released. Ask your team lead for a demo build.
Privacy

Privacy notice: pending review.
